verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` explicitly as a one-shot headless mode designed for CI/CD pipelines, scripts, and batch processing, with structured input/output and tiered autonomy for unattended runs, plus code-review/CI integration and readiness-fix commands that can auto-fix failing criteria. This directly supports invoking an agent from CI to address build/test failures. Missing for 10: an independent/hands-on example of a CI pipeline configuration invoking droid exec to fix a specific failing test/build, rather than just first-party docs.
